annotation.evidence_span: able to turn them on or off
annotation.interpretation_a: The application provides a simple boolean setting to enable or disable keep-alives globally for all connections.
annotation.interpretation_b: The application provides a per-connection setting, allowing fine-grained control over keep-alives for each individual TCP connection.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'able to turn them on or off' is vague. It doesn't specify the granularity of control the application must provide. A global on/off switch satisfies the requirement, but so does a per-connection setting, leading to different implementation approaches.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify *how* the application must be able to turn keep-alives on or off. Is it a global setting, a per-connection setting, or both? This affects implementation complexity.
